mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_records ( id, member_id, jeongmo_id, name, birth_date, jeongmo_date, jeongmo_start_time, jeongmo_end_time, jeongmo_place, reg_dtm, chg_dtm ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{memberId}, #{jeongmoId}, #{name}, #{birthDate}, #{jeongmoDate}, #{jeongmoStartTime}, #{jeongmoEndTime}, #{jeongmoPlace}, #{regDtm}, #{chgDtm} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, jeongmo_id, name, birth_date, jeongmo_date, jeongmo_start_time, jeongmo_end_time, jeongmo_place, reg_dtm, chg_dtm FROM attendance_records WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, member_id, jeongmo_id, name, birth_date, jeongmo_date, jeongmo_start_time, jeongmo_end_time, jeongmo_place, reg_dtm, chg_dtm FROM attendance_records WHERE jeongmo_id = #{jeongmoId} ORDER BY reg_dtm ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_records SET jeongmo_id = NULL, chg_dtm = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE jeongmo_id = #{jeongmoId}
